subject: Air freight quote to PEK
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well. Could you send me an all-in price in EUR for the cheapest air freight option to PEK (Beijing, CN)?

The shipment is furniture samples: 12 pieces with a gross weight of 1378 kg and a volume of 5.12 cbm. It’ll be ready for pickup on 2026-11-25 at our site in 86458 (Augsburg), Germany. Could you arrange the truck from our site to the airport and include that in the quote?

Thanks for taking a look!

Cheers,
Klaus Weidner
Weidner Spielwaren GmbH, Nuremberg
